Ares Alpha brings realtime position of your teammates, a hierarchical chain of command, mission updates from the game organizer, as well as transmission of information to the team leaders on the battlefield.


Features:
* Realtime tracking of your teammates on the battlefield map
* View status of your teammates (dead/alive/medic needed/support)
* Easier navigation on the battlefield, depending on the position of your teammates (reduces the risk of friendly fire)
* Receive orders from your commanders / Send orders to your subordinates
* You can create customized maps of the battlefield on app website for each game/event (ares-alpha.com)
* Supports large events with hundreds, or even thousands of players
* You can create a detailed chain of command, from generals to soldiers.
* Phone notifications for new objectives or orders.
* Perks to improve the gameplay
* Player profile management
* Club management

Recommendations: 
* We recommend the use of an external power bank four your phone. Depending of your phone model there's a chance Ares Alpha will automatically be closed after a longer standby time. Using a power bank, you will avoid this type of situation, ensuring yourself basically unlimited use of Ares during the game.
* To avoid accidents during the game we recommend the use of a protective cover for your phone.

* We recommend the use of a Bluetooth smart band for receiving app notifications. The app was successfully tested on a Xiaomi Mi Smart Band 3, but any other type that allows app notifications should work.

Ares Alpha it's heavy optimized to work on areas with poor levels of phone signal. But, in the rare cases where you don't have any mobile data access, Ares Alpha won't work.

Warning: Ares Alpha is designed for airsoft and paintball activities. Do not use it in any other situations like touristic orientation.
